## What changed
- The cutover moves to **Sunday 22/11, 02:00–04:00 UTC**: Fernhill's month-end batch runs Saturday night until ~06:00. Maya confirmed with Sam, told the CSMs, and cleared you to update the runbook and merge #321 — the Notion page still says Saturday. [8][10]
- Maya approved #321, Terraform and the replica fix included; her only hold was the window confirmation. [3]
- Lior needs 30 minutes' notice before switchover to pause consumers cleanly; ingest workers read `DATABASE_URL` from SSM, so nothing changes on their side. [9]
- Daniel is on call for the API on Sunday and wants a ping when you start the switchover. [7]

## What you did
- Prod blue/green is ready and rehearsed on a snapshot clone: **74 s of write downtime**, no data mismatch, API pods reconnected through pgbouncer; the read replica now follows the blue/green instead of being destroyed and recreated. Rehearsal instances are deleted. [1]

## What is still open
- Rollback rehearsal on a fresh clone **Thursday 19/11**, still a TODO in the runbook: after switchover blue is renamed and takes no writes, so measure how long a rollback takes and what data is lost. [1]
